items.titleEn: Overlap, underlap or sit back? How Premier League teams use their full-backs
items.summaryEn: The role of full-back has changed massively in recent years. We analyse how all 20 sides are approaching the positionBy Opta AnalystOverlapping. Underlapping. Inverted. Traditional. The role of full-back has evolved dramatically. Once a defensive-first position that provided some auxiliary attacking support, the role has developed into something far more multifaceted.Just ask right-back Ben White, who – with Riccardo Calafiori on the left – has been an important figure in Arsenal’s superb start to the campaign. Talking a few years ago, he said: “Playing full-back the way [Mikel Arteta] wants is completely different to any other manager. To play full-back for him, you’ve got to be a centre-midfielder, a centre-back, a winger and a No 10.” Continue reading...
bodyEn: Overlapping. Underlapping. Inverted. Traditional. The role of full-back has evolved dramatically. Once a defensive-first position that provided some auxiliary attacking support, the role has developed into something far more multifaceted.

Just ask right-back Ben White, who – with Riccardo Calafiori on the left – has been an important figure in Arsenal’s superb start to the campaign. Talking a few years ago, he said: “Playing full-back the way [Mikel Arteta] wants is completely different to any other manager. To play full-back for him, you’ve got to be a centre-midfielder, a centre-back, a winger and a No 10.”

Between them, White and Calafiori have contributed to six goals for Arsenal already in the Premier League this season (White: three assists; Calafiori: one goal, two assists). No other defender has registered more than three goal involvements so far. The Arsenal duo are a great illustration of the impact full-backs can have. But, with the position more demanding than ever before, how does each Premier League team deploy theirs?

The graphic below shows the average height and width of the touches of each Premier League team’s full-backs, sorted from highest average position to lowest. The most obvious takeaway is that Arsenal’s full-backs have the highest average touch location of any Premier League side this season, coming 58.2 metres from their own goal.

That is a reflection not only of Arsenal’s territorial dominance, but also the license White and Calafiori are given to push into the attacking line. White averages 3.4 touches in the opposition box per 90 minutes, the most of any full-back or wing-back in the division. Calafiori ranks third, with 2.9.

Arsenal’s full-backs also have the narrowest average touch locations of any team, emphasising how far they have moved away from the traditional full-back role of maintaining width. Instead, they are encouraged to drift inside and operate in central areas.

Tottenham also deploy their full-backs extremely high up the pitch. For most of the campaign, that has been Archie Gray at right-back and Andy Robertson on the left. Of course, analysing a player’s influence is not limited to what they do on the ball. Thanks to Opta Vision, we can also track what they do without it.

Gray is particularly noteworthy, given his exceptional work rate. He ranks first among Premier League full-backs for underlapping runs, both in total (23) and per 90 minutes (2.9), and also ranks fourth for overlapping runs per 90 (1.8). That shows the benefit of deploying an attack-minded player at full-back, with Gray showing energy and an ability to get beyond the ball and offer another option in the final third.

Robertson is no slouch on the opposite flank, either. The 32-year-old ranks seventh for underlapping runs per 90 minutes (1.4) and sits inside the top 20 for overlapping runs per 90 (1.1). He has also received more passes ending in the final third (159) than any other full-back.

It might be more of a surprise to see Coventry’s full-backs play so high, given they have not dominated the ball at all (39.1% possession, second-lowest) and they start their attacks from deep (40.2m away from goal, sixth-lowest). It is, however, something they did to good effect in the Championship last season (average height of 56.8m, sixth-highest).

Frank Lampard has also used a back five at times, which means his wing-backs naturally play higher up, but he has been brave with pushing his defensive line up in general. Coventry have provoked the second-most offsides of any team so far (30).
That has allowed Milan van Ewijk and Jay Dasilva to push forward on the flanks. The pair have each created eight chances, with only Jack Rudoni (12) creating more for the Sky Blues.

Dasilva is a particularly important outlet down the left. He takes his touches higher up the pitch than any other full-back in the division, and Coventry have created 42.2% of their open-play chances down his side, the highest proportion of any Premier League team.

It makes sense that Nottingham Forest and Leeds also see their full-backs touch the ball high up the pitch, given they are two of the biggest users of wing-backs. That pair are two of just four teams that predominantly play with wing-backs, with the back three/five becoming a rare breed in the modern Premier League.

For Leeds, Jayden Bogle has been particularly influential going forwards. He has made more runs ending in the opposition box than any other full-back this season. They’ve come at an average of 3.9 per 90 minutes, the second-highest rate in the division, behind only Nico O’Reilly, who has played just 54.3% of his minutes at full-back.

Crystal Palace, meanwhile, are feeling the effects of losing the influential Daniel Muñoz. Despite playing solely with wing-backs, they have gone from having the highest average full-back positioning in the Premier League in 2025-26 to sitting below the league average this season. Muñoz was relentless in his work up and down the right flank last term, and his absence has clearly affected the extent to which Palace are able to push their right-sided wing-back up in those wide areas.

The Colombian is now at Nottingham Forest with his former manager Oliver Glasner. They have gone from having the fifth-lowest average touch location for their full-backs to the fourth-highest. That is not only down to Muñoz, but having someone who is able to put in consistent lung-busting runs – he is behind only Ipswich Town’s Leif Davis for the average length of his off-ball runs – helps a lot.

We can’t talk about the league’s most energetic full-backs without mentioning Adrien Truffert, who has continued where he left off last season. The Frenchman is the overlapping king, making more of those runs than any other full-back in the division (23). That comes after he made almost twice as many overlapping runs as any other player across the entire league last season. His manager, Andoni Iraola, may be gone, but he’s clearly got the same license to bomb on from Bournemouth’s new head coach, Marco Rose.

Iraola is now at Liverpool, and his full-backs are one of the most asymmetric duos in the league. Milos Kerkez – just as he did at Bournemouth under Iraola – has freedom to push forward and is one of the biggest overlappers in the league, completing 15 such runs thus far. On the other side, Ronald Araújo – who is more of a converted centre-back – plays a far more reserved role.

Manchester City are a curious case. Despite averaging the most possession in the division (65.4%), completing the most passes per game (566) and recording the highest territorial dominance, as measured by field tilt, Enzo Maresca’s team do not use their full-backs in advanced areas to exert that dominance.

Their average full-back touch location is 53.1 metres from goal, making them the fourth-deepest team in the division. That is a huge contrast from Pep Guardiola’s last season, when City ranked third-highest for average full-back positioning. There are plenty of ways to play full-back in the Premier League, but the growing importance of the position is the same for every team.
This is an article by Opta Analyst

items.titleZh: 重叠、内切还是后撤？英超球队如何使用边后卫
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳本赛季开局出色，本·怀特和卡拉菲奥里的边后卫组合触球位置高居英超之首。
bodyZh: 套边。内切。内收。传统。边后卫的角色发生了巨大的演变。这个曾经以防守为主、提供一些辅助进攻支持的位置，已经发展成为一个更加多面化的角色。
问问右后卫本·怀特就知道了，他和左路的里卡多·卡拉菲奥里一起，成为了阿森纳本赛季出色开局的重要人物。几年前在谈到这个位置时，他说：“按照[米克尔·阿尔特塔]想要的方式踢边后卫，与任何其他教练都完全不同。要想为他踢边后卫，你必须是一个中前卫、中后卫、边锋和10号球员。”
在本赛季的英超联赛中，怀特和卡拉菲奥里两人已经联手为阿森纳贡献了六个进球（怀特：三次助攻；卡拉菲奥里：一球两助）。到目前为止，没有任何其他后卫的参与进球数超过三个。阿森纳的这对双人组很好地说明了边后卫能够产生的影响。但是，随着这个位置的要求比以往任何时候都高，每支英超球队又是如何部署他们的边后卫的呢？
下图显示了每支英超球队边后卫触球的平均高度和宽度，按平均位置由高到低排序。最明显的结论是，本赛季阿森纳边后卫的平均触球位置是所有英超球队中最高的，距离本方球门58.2米。
这不仅反映了阿森纳在场上的绝对统治力，也体现了怀特和卡拉菲奥里被赋予了前插进入进攻线的自由。怀特平均每90分钟在对方禁区内触球3.4次，是联赛中所有边后卫或边翼卫中最多的。卡拉菲奥所以2.9次排名第三。
阿森纳边后卫的平均触球位置也是所有球队中最窄的，这强调了他们已经走得多远，不再局限于保持边路的传统边后卫角色。相反，他们被鼓励内切并在中路活动。
托特纳姆热刺也将他们的边后卫部署在球场极高的位置。在大部分比赛中，右后卫是阿奇·格雷，左后卫是安迪·罗伯逊。当然，分析一名球员的影响力不仅限于他在有球时的表现。多亏了Opta Vision，我们还可以追踪他们在无球时的表现。
鉴于其出色的工作投入度，格雷尤其值得关注。他在英超边后卫的内切跑动中排名第一，无论是总数（23次）还是每场90分钟（2.9次），同时他在每90分钟的套边跑动中也排名第四（1.8次）。这显示了在边后卫位置上部署一名进攻型球员的好处，格雷表现出了活力以及超越球并为进攻三区提供另一种选择的能力。
罗伯逊在另一侧边路也毫不逊色。这位32岁的球员在每90分钟内切跑动中排名第七（1.4次），在每90分钟套边跑动中稳居前20名（1.1次）。他还接收了比任何其他边后卫更多的终结在进攻三区的传球（159次）。
看到考文垂的边后卫位置如此靠前可能会让人感到有些惊讶，因为他们根本没有在控球率上占优（39.1%的控球率，倒数第二），而且他们的进攻发起位置很深（距离球门40.2米，倒数第六）。然而，他们在上赛季的英冠联赛中就很好地运用了这一点（平均高度56.8米，排名第六高）。
弗兰克·兰帕德有时也会使用五后卫阵型，这意味着他的边翼卫自然会踢得更高，但他在整体上推动防线前压方面一直非常勇敢。考文垂目前制造了英超第二多的越位次数（30次）。
这使得米兰·范埃维克和杰伊·达席尔瓦得以在边路向前推进。这两人各自创造了8次机会，天蓝色军团中只有杰克·鲁多尼（12次）创造了更多机会。
达席尔瓦是左路一个特别重要的出球点。他在球场更靠前的位置触球，超过了联赛中的任何其他边后卫，考文垂在进攻三区有42.2%的运动战机会都是通过他的这一侧创造的，这是所有英超球队中最高的比例。
诺丁汉森林和利兹联的边后卫触球位置也很高，这合情合理，因为他们是两支大量使用边翼卫的球队。这两支球队是仅有的四支主要使用边翼卫踢球的球队之四，三后卫/五后卫阵型在现代英超联赛中已不多见。
对利兹联来说，杰登·博格尔在进攻端的表现极具影响力。本赛季他完成的进入对方禁区的跑动次数超过了任何其他边后卫。他们的平均频率为每90分钟3.9次，在联赛中排名第二高，仅次于尼科·奥赖利，而后者只有54.3%的出场时间是踢边后卫。
与此同时，水晶宫正感受到失去有影响力的丹尼尔·穆尼奥斯的影响。尽管他们完全采用边翼卫阵型，但他们的边后卫平均战术定位已经从2025-26赛季英超联赛中最高，跌至本赛季的联赛平均水平以下。穆尼奥斯上赛季在右边路的上下奔跑不知疲倦，他的缺席显然影响了水晶宫将右边翼卫推到这些宽广区域的程度。
这位哥伦比亚球员目前效力于诺丁汉森林，与其前任主帅奥利弗·格拉斯纳重聚。他们的边后卫平均触球位置已经从倒数第五跃升至第四高。这不仅归功于穆尼奥斯，还因为拥有一个能够持续进行长距离冲刺的球员——他在无球跑动平均长度上仅次于伊普斯维奇镇的利夫·戴维斯——这带来了巨大的帮助。
提到联赛中最具活力的边后卫，就不能不提阿德里安·特吕费尔，他延续了上赛季的出色状态。这位法国人是套边之王，他的这类跑动次数比联赛中任何其他边后卫都要多（23次）。此前在上个赛季，他的套边跑动次数几乎是整个联赛中其他任何球员的两倍。他的主帅安多尼·伊劳拉可能已经离开，但他在伯恩茅斯新主帅马科·罗斯的麾下，显然获得了同样的自由向前冲击的许可。
伊劳拉现在执教利物浦，他的边后卫是联赛中最不对称的双人组之一。米洛斯·克尔克兹——正如他在伊劳拉手下的伯恩茅斯那样——拥有前插的自由，并且是联赛中最主要的套边球员之一，到目前为止已经完成了15次此类跑动。在另一侧，罗纳德·阿劳霍——他更像是一个由中后卫改造成地球员——扮演着更加保守的角色。
曼城是一个奇怪的例子。尽管恩佐·马雷斯卡率领的球队拥有联赛最高的平均控球率（65.4%）、完成了最多的单场传球（566次），并记录了以球场倾斜度衡量的最高领地统治力，但他们并没有利用边后卫在先进区域来施加这种统治力。
他们边后卫的平均触球位置距离球门53.1米，是联赛中第四靠后的球队。这与佩普·瓜迪奥拉执教的最后一个赛季形成了巨大对比，当时曼城边后卫的平均定位排名第三高。在英超联赛中踢边后卫有很多种方法，但这个位置日益增长的重要性对每支球队来说都是一样的。
这是一篇由Opta Analyst撰写的文章。

items.titleEn: Peter Storey, Arsenal Double winner and England international, dies aged 81
items.summaryEn: Storey made 501 appearances for Arsenal from 1965He won 19 England caps and finished career at FulhamArsenal have paid tribute to Peter Storey, a key member of their 1971 Double-winning team, after the death of the former England midfielder at the age of 81.Storey was part of the Bertie Mee team that secured the First Division title and FA Cup in a season that remains one of the most celebrated in Arsenal’s history and played 501 times for the club. That places him eighth on their appearances list. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Arsenal have paid tribute to Peter Storey, a key member of their 1971 Double-winning team, after the death of the former England midfielder at the age of 81.

Storey was part of the Bertie Mee team that secured the First Division title and FA Cup in a season that remains one of the most celebrated in Arsenal’s history and played 501 times for the club. That places him eighth on their appearances list.
Storey, who represented England on 19 occasions from 1971-73, earned respect for his uncompromising approach and versatility, also featuring at right-back.

Storey died in hospital after a short illness, surrounded by his family. Arsenal said: “Everyone at Arsenal is deeply saddened by the passing of 1970-71 Double winner Peter Storey. All our thoughts are with his family and loved ones at this incredibly sad time.”

Born in Surrey, Storey began his career at Arsenal and made his debut shortly after his 20th birthday in 1965. He is fondly remembered by the club’s fans for scoring a stoppage-time penalty in the 1971 FA Cup semi-final against Stoke that forced a replay and kept the Double dream alive.

Storey left for Fulham in 1977 and retired eight months later when his contract was cancelled, going on to own a pub in north London. He was later convicted of several criminal offences, including financing a plot to counterfeit gold coins and smuggling pornography. He released an autobiography, True Storey: My Life and Crimes as a Football Hatchet Man, in September 2010.

Storey’s family said: “We are deeply grateful for the many kind messages, tributes and good wishes we have received. It has been a great comfort to see the affection and respect in which he was held by so many, both within the football community and beyond.”

items.titleZh: 阿森纳双冠王得主兼英格兰国脚彼得·斯托瑞去世，享年81岁
items.summaryZh: 前阿森纳中场、1971年双冠王功臣彼得·斯托瑞逝世，享年81岁。
bodyZh: 阿森纳向彼得·斯托瑞致以敬意。这位前英格兰中场球员去世，享年81岁，他是阿森纳1971年双冠王阵容的关键成员。
斯托瑞效力于伯蒂·米率领的球队，在那个阿森纳历史上最著名的赛季中夺得甲级联赛冠军和足总杯冠军。他为俱乐部出场501次，在队史出场次数榜上排名第八。
斯托瑞在1971年至1973年间代表英格兰国家队出场19次，他以凶悍的防守风格和多面手属性赢得尊重，也曾担任右后卫。
斯托瑞在经历短暂疾病后于医院去世，家属陪伴在侧。阿森纳表示：“阿森纳的每个人都对1970-71赛季双冠王得主彼得·斯托瑞的离去深感悲痛。在这个极其悲伤的时刻，我们所有的心都与他的家属和亲人在一起。”
斯托瑞出生于萨里，在阿森纳开始职业生涯，1965年在20岁生日后不久完成首秀。俱乐部球迷对他在1971年足总杯半决赛对阵斯托克城的比赛中罚入伤停补时点球记忆犹新，这粒进球迫使比赛进入重赛，并延续了双冠王梦想。
斯托瑞于1977年转会富勒姆，并在八个月后合同终止时退役，随后在伦敦北部经营一家酒吧。他后来因多项刑事犯罪被定罪，包括资助伪造金币阴谋和走私色情制品。2010年9月，他出版了自传《真实故事：我作为足球恶汉的生活与罪行》。
斯托瑞的家属表示：“我们非常感激收到的许多暖心留言、致敬和祝福。看到足球界内外的许多人对他的喜爱和尊敬，给我们带来了极大的安慰。”

items.titleEn: Disabled Supporters' Ticket Info | Crystal Palace (A)
bodyEn: Crystal Palace v ArsenalSunday 27th December Premier LeagueSelhurst ParkKick Off: 19:00

All tickets for this game will be NFC Digital Passes and will be sent to each lead client and must be added to a mobile device prior to arrival at Selhurst Park. Please ensure that your email address details are up to date.
Tickets will be sent from Monday, December 21. If you have not received your tickets by Wednesday, December 23, please contact our Supporter Services Team on 020 7619 5000 (option 1).
Supporters aged 13 and under must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder when entering Selhurst Park.
Selhurst Park is a cashless stadium, please note that cash will not be accepted at any food and drink outlets in the Arthur Wait Stand.

We ask that you only purchase a ticket if you are planning to attend the match. Our goal is to ensure that as many supporters as possible have the chance to attend this game, and that our away support remains vibrant and passionate.
When attending away fixtures, please ensure that your match ticket is scanned. It is your responsibility to make sure that your ticket is scanned correctly at the turnstile.
If your match ticket does not scan at the relevant turnstile, or if a steward admits you through another entrance, please ensure that your ticket is scanned before entering the ground.

If you do have access issues on the day of the game, please speak to a steward or seek advice from the hosting club’s ticket office before entering the ground to confirm that your match attendance is recorded.

Arsenal monitors away match attendance from access control data which is recorded at the hosting club’s ground. Arsenal receives this information directly from the hosting club and uses the data to confirm attendance or to deduct away match points.
Please be aware that documentation will not be accepted to prove away match attendance and this includes photographs, receipts, travel or hotel bookings.

If you fail to scan your away match ticket, Arsenal will not receive information that you attended the fixture, and the away match loyalty point that has been credited to your membership account will be removed for the relevant away game.
The club also reserves the right to implement further point removals for repeated occurrences as set out under section 3.10 of the Arsenal Away Match Ticket Terms and Conditions Season 2026-2027.
Allocation Information Wheelchair spaces – 29 pairsAmbulant disabled seating – 28 pairs
Disability Access Ticket Prices Wheelchair Users and Ambulant Disabled
Tickets for disabled supporters will be priced at the relevant age category and will include a complimentary personal assistant ticket, subject to eligibility.
Sales Phases

From this season, Red, Cannon, Junior Gunners, and Young Gun DA Members will now be able to earn away points on all eligible fixtures. These points will build your priority for future away matches, giving you access to the ticket purchase window based on the away points you’ve accumulated.
Sales Window 1 Tickets will go on sale on Monday 23rd November at 10am to all Disability Access members with 35+ Away points.
Sales Window 2 Tickets will go on sale on Monday 23rd November at 2pm to all Disability Access members with 30+ Away points.
Sales Window 3 Tickets will go on sale on Tuesday 24th November at 10am to all current Disability Access members with 25+ Away points.
Sales Window 4 Tickets will go on sale on Tuesday 24th November at 2pm to all current Disability Access members with 20+ Away points.
Sales Window 5Tickets will go on sale on Wednesday 25th November at 10am to all Disability Access members with 15+ Away points.
Sales Window 6Tickets will go on sale on Wednesday 25th November at 2pm to all current Disability Access members with 10+ Away points.
If tickets remain after window 6, we will announce further sales windows.

To book tickets please call 0207 619 5000 (option 2). Please be aware that the phone line can be busy at times so you may be held in a queue. Deaf supporters, who use British Sign Language (BSL), can contact the Disability Liaison Team by using SignVideo BSL Interpreter service.

Please note, if you wish to purchase in a 2pm booking period, you will be entered into a queue at 1.45pm before the phone lines re-open to you at 2pm. If you qualify in the previous booking period and haven’t purchased prior to this time, you will need to purchase in the new booking period.
Away Ticket ExchangeThe Away Ticket Exchange service will open once this fixture has sold out.

Supporters collecting duplicate tickets on the day of the fixture, will be required to provide photo ID. The ID must match the name on the assigned ticket and photographs of ID are not valid. Third party ticket collections are also not permitted.

As ticket exchange is not currently available online for disabled supporters, you can register your interest in tickets via a form once the match has sold out. If any tickets are returned, we will contact supporters on a first come first served basis.

Please fill in this form if you are interested in attending. This form will only open once the fixture has sold out and will close on Monday 1st December at 5pm. If any tickets become available, we will contact you at the earliest opportunity.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳公布客场对阵水晶宫的残疾球迷购票及入场须知。
bodyZh: 水晶宫对阵阿森纳 12月27日星期日 英超 塞尔赫斯特公园球场 开球时间：19:00
本场比赛的所有球票均为NFC数字通行证，将发送至每个主要客户，必须在抵达塞尔赫斯特公园球场前添加至移动设备。请确保您的电子邮件地址信息是最新的。
球票将于12月21日星期一开始发送。如果您在12月23日星期三之前仍未收到球票，请致电020 7619 5000（按1）联系我们的球迷服务团队。
13岁及以下的球迷在进入塞尔赫斯特公园球场时必须由成年持票人陪同。
塞尔赫斯特公园球场是无现金球场，请注意亚瑟维特看台的任何餐饮售卖点均不接受现金。
我们请求您仅在计划现场观赛的情况下购票。我们的目标是确保尽可能多的球迷有机会观看这场比赛，并保持我们客场支持的充满活力与激情。
观看客场比赛时，请确保您的比赛球票已被扫描。您有责任确保您的球票在闸机处被正确扫描。
如果您的比赛球票未能在相关闸机处扫描，或者工作人员允许您通过其他入口进入，请确保在进入球场前扫描球票。
如果您在比赛当天遇到入场问题，请在进入球场前咨询工作人员或寻求主队售票处的建议，以确认您的现场观赛记录已被录入。
阿森纳通过主队球场记录的出入控制数据来监督客场比赛出勤率。阿森纳直接从主队获取此信息，并利用这些数据来确认出勤率或扣除客场积分。
请注意，证明客场出勤率的文档将不被接受，这包括照片、收据、行程或酒店预订。
如果您未能扫描客场比赛球票，阿森纳将不会收到您出席比赛的信息，并且已记入您会员账户的相关客场比赛积分将被移除。
根据2026-2027赛季阿森纳客场比赛球票条款和条件第3.10条的规定，俱乐部也保留对重复发生的情况实施进一步扣除积分的权利。
分配信息 轮椅席位 – 29对 步行残疾座位 – 28对
无障碍通道球票价格 轮椅使用者和步行残疾人
残疾球迷的球票将按相关年龄类别定价，并且在符合资格的情况下包含一张免费的个人助理球票。
销售阶段
从本赛季开始，红色会员、卡农会员、青年枪手和年轻枪手残疾通道会员现在将能够在所有符合条件的比赛中获得客场积分。这些积分将建立您未来客场比赛的优先权，根据您累积的客场积分让您获得购票窗口。
销售窗口1 球票将于11月23日星期日上午10点向所有拥有35分以上客场积分的残疾通道会员开售。
销售窗口2 球票将于11月23日星期日下午2点向所有拥有30分以上客场积分的残疾通道会员开售。
销售窗口3 球票将于11月24日星期二上午10点向所有当前拥有25分以上客场积分的残疾通道会员开售。
销售窗口4 球票将于11月24日星期二下午2点向所有当前拥有20分以上客场积分的残疾通道会员开售。
销售窗口5 球票将于11月25日星期三上午10点向所有残疾通道会员开售，积分要求为15分以上。
销售窗口6 球票将于11月25日星期三下午2点向所有当前残疾通道会员开售，积分要求为10分以上。
如果窗口6之后仍有剩余球票，我们将公布进一步的销售窗口。
如需预订球票，请致电0207 619 5000（按2）。请注意，电话线路有时会很忙，您可能会在队列中等待。使用英国手语（BSL）的聋哑球迷可以通过使用SignVideo BSL手语翻译服务联系残疾联络团队。
请注意，如果您希望在下午2点的预订时段购买，您将在下午1:45进入队列，之后电话线路在下午2点重新向您开放。如果您符合前一个预订时段的资格但在此时之前尚未购买，您将需要在新的预订时段购买。
客场球票交易 客场球票交易服务将在本场比赛售罄后开放。
在比赛当天领取补发球票的球迷需要提供带照片的身份证件。身份证件必须与分配球票上的姓名相符，身份证件的照片无效。也不允许第三方代领球票。
由于球票交易目前不在线向残疾球迷开放，您可以在比赛售罄后通过表格登记您对球票的兴趣。如果有任何退票，我们将按先到先得的原则联系球迷。
如果您有兴趣参加，请填写此表格。此表格仅在比赛售罄后开放，并将于12月1日星期一至下午5点关闭。如果有任何可用球票，我们会尽快与您联系。
